RESOLVED, that the board approves the annual budget for the
financial year ending 31 December 2026, as presented.

# Recitals

State the background that supports the resolution. Name the
meeting, the authority, and the document under which the board
acts.

# Resolved clauses

State each resolved clause in numbered paragraphs. Write each
clause so it stands alone as an instruction to the company.

# Certification

State who certifies the resolution and how. The secretary signs
the record of the resolution.
